_about: ACADEMY PIPELINE (owner 2026-10-21, ACADEMY-2026-10-21; guide docs/guide/pages/academy.md). An account added on the dashboard as 'Academy mage (automatic)' gets a random character (name + digits), goes to Giran with .giran, is invited into the clan ACADEMY by the clan leader, gets adena from the givers (fund round), buys its kit, levels 1-40 alone, changes class at 20 and 40 (the 2nd class change graduates it: the clan gets the Academy reputation), logs out, and the account makes the next academy character (until its character slots are full). Read live by swarm.js (academy steps) and Dashboard/academy_api.js (the manager). Edit by hand: the next characters use the new values.

buffs._about: ACADSTORE-2026-10-31 (owner: 'make sure you have spiritshots and full buffs. Also take Magnus Chant from giran for 10 adena'): at the Giran start (start kit) and on every Giran supply run / rebuff trip the academy character buys these from a player buff store (sellers found by their title) for itself, at most storeMaxPrice adena per buff

_coupons: ACADCOUPON-2026-10-31 (owner: 'Have You added the shadow item coupons for academy toons' -> 'Option 1'): true = new academy plans stop at a Newbie Guide at level 6 (5 weapon coupons -> 1 shadow weapon) and right after the 1st class change (jewelry coupon -> D shadow jewelry); free, worn only when better. false = off.

names._about: a name = one of 'first' + one of 'second' + 2-4 digits (max 16 letters/digits in total)

funds._about: adena an academy character asks the givers for (fund_rules.json chars.<Name>.target wins); it waits in Giran until it has 'need' (max waitMin)

buy._level20: ACADROUTE-2026-11-01: a piece with equip is skipped when the worn piece of that slot is as good (the free shadow robe set from the guide's armor coupon); the weapon + the D spiritshots are still bought
buy._level18: ACADARMOR18-2026-11-02 (owner yes): the Devotion robe set (no grade) + Leather Helmet bought in Giran BEFORE quest 412 Path Of The Dark Wizard (deaths there in starter gear); the level20 kit then skips the worn pieces

spots._about: where it levels (party plan level steps). ACADROUTE-2026-11-01 (owner's route, docs/plan/academy_route_owner.md): to20 = levels 1-20, to30 = 20-30 (the leader picks for the level), to35 = 30-35 Cruma Marshlands (datapack 'Cruma Tower (Lv30-35)'), to40 = 35-40 Cruma Tower floor 1 Porta rooms (level-40 monsters, the lowest on that floor; override = the owner accepted the level gap). to25 (Ant Nest) is no longer used by new plans.

end._about: after the 2nd class change: logout + the next academy character on the same account (newCharacter false = only log out)
end._loop: ACADLOOP-2026-10-31 (owner: 'after each academy toon graduate to deliver items to collector and all adena and items. Then log out ... Then set that character for deletion and create a new academy toon and do it over again ... It should run 24/7'): deliver = before the logout everything tradeable + all adena to the collector (Storage: collector, else the clan leader); deleteGraduate = the next create marks graduated pipeline characters for deletion (only characters this pipeline made, Logs/academy_manager.json madeNames) and maxCharacters no longer stops the loop; full slots = wait slotWaitMin and try again
